name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp MiaAI-Lab（4 节点 TP=4）
description: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp 四节点 TP=4 DSpark 服务（基于 hotfix8 镜像，支持任意 TP）：原生图片输入（OpenAI image_url ≤8/仅 user/无视频）、FlashInfer b12x + dspark 投机 k=3（实测最优，k=6 单流 46.5 / k=3 单流 54.9 t/s）、NVFP4 DS-MLA、1M 上下文、每 rank KV 池 ~51 GiB（~7.57M token）。实机基准（4×GB10, 散文 decode, reasoning off）：单流 54.9 t/s；ws=6 聚合 160 t/s（K=3 峰值）；TTFT ≤0.34s @36k prompt；统一内存占用 121G 预算几乎吃满（avail 2-3G 稳定）。TP8 不可行：FlashInfer DSV4 稀疏 MLA 预填内核仅支持 num_heads∈{16,32,64,128}，模型 64 头 ÷ 8 无模板。
compose_template:
services:
  vllm-dspark:
    image: ${DSPARK_VLLM_IMAGE:-registry.cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/aixn-public/dspark-vllm-gx10-mia:v0.1.1-hotfix8}
    container_name: ${TASK_NAME}-rank${NODE_RANK}
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "python3", "-c", "import urllib.request,sys; sys.exit(0 if urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:${VLLM_PORT:-8888}/health', timeout=5).status == 200 else 1)"]
      interval: 30s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 3
      start_period: 900s
    pull_policy: if_not_present
    network_mode: host
    ipc: host
    shm_size: "64gb"
    ulimits:
      memlock: -1
      stack: 67108864
    gpus: all
    devices:
      - /dev/infiniband:/dev/infiniband
    volumes:
      - ${HF_CACHE:-${HOME}/.cache/huggingface}:/cache/huggingface
      - ${HOME}/.cache/vllm-cache:/cache/huggingface/vllm-cache
      - ${DSPARK_TMP_HOST:-${HOME}/.cache/dspark-tmp}:/tmp
    environment:
      HF_HOME: /cache/huggingface
      HF_HUB_OFFLINE: "1"  # 模型由管理平台分发到节点缓存，固定离线加载，避免启动时访问 HF
      TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE: "${TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE:-0}"
      HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET: "${HF_HUB_DISABLE_XET:-1}"
      DSPARK_MODEL: "${DSPARK_MODEL:-deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp}"
      DSPARK_REVISION: "${DSPARK_REVISION:-}"
      SERVED_MODEL_NAME: "${SERVED_MODEL_NAME:-deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp}"
      DSPARK_SERVE_PORT: "${VLLM_PORT:-8888}"  # API 端口仅作 --port 传入；不再导出 VLLM_PORT，避免 vLLM 内部端口从 8888 起扫
      LIMIT_MM_PER_PROMPT: "${LIMIT_MM_PER_PROMPT:-image=8}"  # 每请求图片上限（image=N 简写由镜像入口转成 Anemll 的 JSON；Vision-Exp 无视频）
      MAX_MODEL_LEN: "${MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1048576}"
      MAX_NUM_SEQS: "${MAX_NUM_SEQS:-6}"
      MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS: "${MAX_NUM_BATCHED_TOKENS:-8192}"
      LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD: "${LONG_PREFILL_TOKEN_THRESHOLD:-1024}"
      GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION: "${GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION:-0.835}"
      MTP_NUM_TOKENS: "${MTP_NUM_TOKENS:-3}"  # 4 节点实测：k=3 优于 k=6（草稿 n_predict=3 档位；k=6 单流降 15%）
      DSPARK_TP: "${DSPARK_TP:-4}"  # --tensor-parallel-size（hotfix8 参数化入口；4 节点 = 4）
      DEFAULT_THINKING: "${DEFAULT_THINKING:-low}"
      DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD: "${DRAFT_SAMPLE_METHOD:-probabilistic}"
      VLLM_HOST_IP: "${VLLM_HOST_IP:-}"
      # JIT 编译缓存持久化（HF 卷，容器重建不丢；镜像入口脚本 + vLLM 运行时消费）
      VLLM_CACHE_ROOT: /cache/huggingface/vllm-cache
      TRITON_CACHE_DIR: /cache/huggingface/triton-cache
      TILELANG_CACHE_DIR: /cache/huggingface/tilelang-cache
      B12X_CUTE_COMPILE_CACHE_DIR: /cache/huggingface/b12x-cute-cache
      DG_JIT_CACHE_DIR: /tmp/deep-gemm
      VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL: "${VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL:-4096}"
      VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB: "${VLLM_SPARSE_INDEXER_MAX_LOGITS_MB:-256}"
      VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS: "${VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS:-1800}"
      VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN: "${VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN:-1}"
      # 热修复开关（镜像内 bake 的 Mia 入口脚本消费，fail-closed）
      DSPARK_SKIP_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_SKIP_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_SKIP_ISSUE22_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_SKIP_ISSUE22_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_SKIP_SUPPRESS_STOPS_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_SKIP_SUPPRESS_STOPS_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING: "${DSPARK_SUPPRESS_STOPS_IN_REASONING:-1}"
      DSPARK_MAX_INFLIGHT_PREFILLS: "${DSPARK_MAX_INFLIGHT_PREFILLS:-1}"
      DSPARK_ISSUE43_SCHED_DIAG: "${DSPARK_ISSUE43_SCHED_DIAG:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE31_GPU_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE31_GPU_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ASSISTANT_FINAL_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ASSISTANT_FINAL_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE136_XGRAMMAR_HOTFIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE136_XGRAMMAR_HOTFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE138_RESPONSES_HISTORY_COMPAT: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE138_RESPONSES_HISTORY_COMPAT:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE141_SPARSE_MLA_CHUNK: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE141_SPARSE_MLA_CHUNK:-0}"
      # 09-05/09-06 opt-in 热修复（hotfix7 镜像 bake，默认关，环境可注入）
      DSPARK_ENABLE_DSPARK_SWA_PREFIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_DSPARK_SWA_PREFIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_DSPARK_BLOCK_K: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_DSPARK_BLOCK_K:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ROPE_SWA_FIX: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ROPE_SWA_FIX:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_DSML_RECOVERY: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_DSML_RECOVERY:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE144_EFFORT_ALIGN: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE144_EFFORT_ALIGN:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_MXFP4_INDEXER_CACHE: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_MXFP4_INDEXER_CACHE:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_DEEPGEMM_SM121_ALIAS: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_DEEPGEMM_SM121_ALIAS:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_C128A_PREFILL_CACHE: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_C128A_PREFILL_CACHE:-0}"
      DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE191_TOOLCALL_FAILCLOSED: "${DSPARK_ENABLE_ISSUE191_TOOLCALL_FAILCLOSED:-0}"
      DSPARK_API_KEYS: "${DSPARK_API_KEYS:-}"
      # 分布式 / NCCL（Fireworks 自动填充 MASTER_ADDR / NODE_RANK / HEADLESS / VLLM_HOST_IP / NCCL_*）
      MASTER_ADDR: "${MASTER_ADDR}"
      MASTER_PORT: "${MASTER_PORT:-25000}"
      NODES_TOTAL: "${NODES_TOTAL:-4}"
      NODE_RANK: "${NODE_RANK}"
      HEADLESS: "${HEADLESS:-}"
      NCCL_NET: "${NCCL_NET:-IB}"
      NCCL_IB_HCA: "${NCCL_IB_HCA:-}"
      NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME:-}"
      TP_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${TP_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME: "${GLOO_SOCKET_IFNAME:-${NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME}}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX: "${NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX:-}"
      NCCL_IB_GID_AUTO: "1"
      NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS: "${NCCL_IB_MERGE_NICS:-}"
      NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL: "${NCCL_NET_GDR_LEVEL:-}"
      NCCL_NET_GDR_READ: "${NCCL_NET_GDR_READ:-}"
      NCCL_DMABUF_ENABLE: "${NCCL_DMABUF_ENABLE:-}"
      NCCL_IB_ADDR_FAMILY: AF_INET
      NCCL_IB_ROCE_VERSION_NUM: 2
      NCCL_CROSS_NIC: "1"
      NCCL_NVLS_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE: "0"
      NCCL_IGNORE_CPU_AFFINITY: "1"
      NCCL_DEBUG: WARN
      CUTE_DSL_ARCH: "${CUTE_DSL_ARCH:-sm_121a}"
      TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "${TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST:-12.1a}"
      FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "${FLASHINFER_CUDA_ARCH_LIST:-12.1a}"
      FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK: "${FLASHINFER_DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK:-1}"
      FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE: "${FLASHINFER_WORKSPACE_BASE:-/cache/huggingface/flashinfer}"
      TORCH_FR_BUFFER_SIZE: "${TORCH_FR_BUFFER_SIZE:-2000}"
      TORCH_NCCL_DUMP_ON_TIMEOUT: "${TORCH_NCCL_DUMP_ON_TIMEOUT:-1}"
      TORCH_NCCL_ENABLE_MONITORING: "${TORCH_NCCL_ENABLE_MONITORING:-1}"
      TORCH_FR_DUMP_TEMP_FILE: "${TORCH_FR_DUMP_TEMP_FILE:-/cache/huggingface/nccl-fr/comm_lib_trace_rank_}"
      TORCH_NCCL_DEBUG_INFO_PIPE_FILE: "${TORCH_NCCL_DEBUG_INFO_PIPE_FILE:-/tmp/fr_dump_pipe_}"
      VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER: "${VLLM_USE_FLASHINFER_SAMPLER:-1}"
      VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH: "${VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH:-0}"
      VLLM_USE_B12X_MOE: "${VLLM_USE_B12X_MOE:-1}"
      VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS: "${VLLM_MEMORY_PROFILER_ESTIMATE_CUDAGRAPHS:-0}"
      PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF: "${PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF:-expandable_segments:True}"
    # 无 command/entrypoint 覆盖：镜像内 /opt/dspark/entrypoint.sh 应用热修复后 exec vllm serve

variables.label: vLLM 镜像
variables.help: Mia hotfix8 镜像（快照 957890ac… + 入口 TP 参数化 DSPARK_TP/NODES_TOTAL，4 节点可配 TP=4）
variables.help_en: Mia hotfix8 image (snapshot 957890ac… + parametrized DSPARK_TP/NODES_TOTAL entrypoint for 4-node TP=4)

variables.label: 张量并行度（TP）
variables.help: --tensor-parallel-size；4 节点固定 4。TP8 不可用（FlashInfer 稀疏 MLA 无 8 头模板）。
variables.help_en: --tensor-parallel-size; 4 for 4 nodes. TP8 unavailable (FlashInfer sparse-MLA lacks an 8-head template).

variables.label: 模型
variables.help: 从已下载模型中选择（控制平面下载后分发到各节点缓存）
variables.help_en: Pick from downloaded models (control plane downloads and distributes)

variables.label: vLLM API 端口
variables.help: API 服务端口（serve --port）；已与 vLLM 内部端口解耦
variables.help_en: API server port (serve --port); decoupled from vLLM internal ports

variables.label: 最大并发序列数
variables.help: 实测 ws=6 吞吐峰值（K=3：160 t/s 聚合）；≥8 每流延迟不均匀
variables.help_en: ws=6 measured throughput peak (K=3: ~160 t/s aggregate); >=8 per-stream latency gets uneven

variables.label: GPU 显存利用率
variables.help: 默认 0.835；显存紧张或图形捕获 OOM 时降至 ~0.80
variables.help_en: Default 0.835; lower toward ~0.80 if graph capture OOMs

variables.label: DSpark 投机 token 数
variables.help: 4 节点实测最优 k=3（DSpark 草稿 n_predict=3，接受率最高；k=6 需被 3 整除，单流 46.5 vs 54.9 t/s）
variables.help_en: k=3 measured best on 4 nodes (DSpark draft n_predict=3, highest acceptance; k must be divisible by 3; k=6: 46.5 vs k=3: 54.9 t/s single-stream)

variables.label: 长 prefill 阈值（token）
variables.help: 超过该 token 量的 prefill 分块处理，避免挤占 decode
variables.help_en: Prefills above this token count are chunked to keep decode fed

variables.label: Prefix-cache 保留间隔
variables.help: SWA prefix-cache 检查点间隔；调试命中率时才调整
variables.help_en: SWA prefix-cache checkpoint spacing; tune only when debugging cache hits

variables.label: 默认思考模式
variables.help: 默认 low（对齐上游当前默认）；off 不思考（最快）、max 最深；请求级可覆盖
variables.help_en: Default low (aligned with upstream's current default); off: no thinking (fastest), max: deepest; overridable per request

variables.label: 每请求图片上限
variables.help: 每请求图片数上限（仅 user 消息可带图；无视频）
variables.help_en: Max images per request (user messages only; no video)

variables.label: Head 节点地址
variables.help: 自动填充 head 节点的 RoCE IP（多节点协调地址，随任务的 head 变化）
variables.help_en: Filled with the head node's RoCE IP (multi-node coordination address, follows per-task head)

variables.label: 节点总数
variables.help: 由任务节点数自动填充（本配方为固定 2 节点拓扑，发布时校验恰好匹配）
variables.help_en: Auto-filled from task node count (fixed 2-node topology; publish validates exact match)

variables.label: Headless（worker 不跑 API server）
variables.help: 自动按角色填充：head 为空、worker 为 1（mp 多节点协调必需）

variables.label: 本节点 vLLM 绑定 IP
variables.help: 必须为各节点 RoCE IP，避免分布式绑定错误地址
variables.help_en: Must be each node's RoCE IP to avoid binding the wrong address

variables.label: RoCE HCA
variables.help: 如 rocep1s0f0

variables.label: NCCL 网络接口
variables.help: 如 enp1s0f0np0

variables.label: RoCE GID index
variables.help: 每节点/HCA 不同且重启漂移，自动解析

variables.label: 官方 Vision-Exp revision
variables.help: 留空 = 自动用缓存快照 sha（离线安全）；显式填写必须是实际分发的 commit
variables.help_en: Empty = auto-resolve the cached snapshot sha (offline-safe); if set, must be the exact distributed commit

variables.label: 跳过 v0.27 perf 回移植
variables.help: 1 = 跳过 6 个 v0.27 性能回移植热修复
variables.help_en: 1 = skip the six v0.27 perf-backport hotfixes

variables.label: 跳过 #22 长上下文修复
variables.help: 1 = 跳过 nvfp4_ds_mla 长上下文解码修复（不推荐）
variables.help_en: 1 = skip the nvfp4_ds_mla long-context decode fix (not recommended)

variables.label: 跳过 stop-stops 修复
variables.help: 1 = 不应用 suppress-stops-in-reasoning 补丁
variables.help_en: 1 = skip the suppress-stops-in-reasoning patch

variables.label: 抑制思考中的 stop
variables.help: 1（默认）= 思考阶段客户端 stop 字符串保持休眠
variables.help_en: 1 (default) = client stop strings stay dormant inside thinking

variables.label: 并发 in-flight prefill 上限
variables.help: 1（上游当前默认）；1–3 可选，更高需实况压测
variables.help_en: 1 (upstream current default); 1-3 selectable; higher needs live load testing

variables.label: #43 调度诊断日志
variables.help: 1 = 每步输出调度行（scheduled prefill/decode）用于诊断
variables.help_en: 1 = one scheduler line per step in the vLLM log (diagnostics)

variables.label: 启用 thinking_token_budget
variables.help: 1 = 启用 GPU thinking_token_budget（stock 下请求该字段会 400）
variables.help_en: 1 = enable GPU thinking_token_budget (stock rejects the field with 400)

variables.label: 启用 assistant-final 热修复
variables.help: 1 = 消息以 assistant 结尾时补生成头
variables.help_en: 1 = append a generation header for assistant-final requests

variables.label: 启用 XGrammar 终止修复
variables.help: 1 = 应用 XGrammar 终止回移植修复
variables.help_en: 1 = apply the XGrammar termination backport

variables.label: 启用 Responses 历史回放兼容
variables.help: 1 = 兼容缺 type 的 assistant output_text 回放
variables.help_en: 1 = accept type-less assistant output_text replay

variables.label: 启用 sparse-MLA 64 行分块
variables.help: 1 = sparse-MLA decode 固定 64 行分块（随机卡死 workaround）
variables.help_en: 1 = chunk sparse-MLA decode to fixed 64-row views (stochastic-stall workaround)

variables.label: 启用 DSpark SWA prefix 修复
variables.help: 1 = 前缀缓存命中时重算草稿滑窗（Anemll #2 移植，避免重复相同 prompt 退化成截断输出）
variables.help_en: 1 = recompute the draft sliding window on prefix-cache hits (Anemll #2 port; repeated identical prompts otherwise degenerate to a truncated response)

variables.label: 启用 DSpark block-k 解锁
variables.help: 1 = 投机 k 跟随训练 dspark_block_size(5)（Vision-Exp 可跑 k=5 而非强制 6；须 MTP_NUM_TOKENS≥1）
variables.help_en: 1 = speculative k follows the trained dspark_block_size(5) (Vision-Exp can run k=5 instead of the forced 6; requires MTP_NUM_TOKENS>=1)

variables.label: 启用 C128A prefill 元数据缓存
variables.help: 1 = 同一 forward 元数据内复用 C128A prefill 索引转换（SM120 注意力路径，上游 09-06 可选项）
variables.help_en: 1 = reuse the C128A prefill index conversion across layers sharing one forward's metadata (SM120 path, upstream 09-06 opt-in)

variables.label: 多 Key API 认证
variables.help: 空格分隔的 API key（任一即可）；留空 = 无认证；勿与 VLLM_API_KEY 同设
variables.help_en: Space-separated API keys (any one authorizes); empty = no auth; do not combine with VLLM_API_KEY

description_en: 4-node TP=4 DSpark serving for DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp (based on the hotfix8 image, tensor-parallel parametrized): native image input (OpenAI image_url ≤8 / user-only / no video), FlashInfer b12x + dspark k=3 speculation (measured best; k=6 46.5 vs k=3 54.9 t/s single-stream), NVFP4 DS-MLA, 1M context, ~51 GiB KV pool per rank (~7.57M tokens). Tested on 4xGB10 (prose decode, reasoning off): 54.9 t/s single-stream; ~160 t/s aggregate at ws=6 (K=3 peak); TTFT ≤0.34s @36k prompt; unified-memory 121G budget nearly exhausted (avail 2-3G stable). TP8 impossible: FlashInfer DSV4 sparse-MLA prefill kernels instantiate only num_heads∈{16,32,64,128}; 64 heads ÷ 8 has no template.
